# Lake Park Bicycles

> North Palm Beach's family-owned bike shop since 1975. Mobile bike repair (doorstep tune-ups) plus bike and e-bike rentals delivered across the Palm Beaches. We come to you - pickup and delivery.

## Services
- $129 Full Tune-Up (summer sale, reg $169), free doorstep pickup and delivery: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/tune-up
- Bike repair and service, any make including e-bikes: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/service
- Bike and e-bike rentals, delivered to your door: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/rentals

## Service areas
- Jupiter: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/jupiter
- Palm Beach Gardens: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/palm-beach-gardens
- Juno Beach: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/juno-beach
- North Palm Beach: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/north-palm-beach
- Lake Park: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/lake-park
- Singer Island: https://www.lakeparkbicycles.com/singer-island
